card.name: British-spelling text, directions and co- words
card.fires_on: Fires on words in British-style text, such as a compass word after 'in the' or 'of', the start of 'co-' or 'sub-' compounds, and the spelling 'programme'. Also fires on a space or comma at a clause boundary.
